Specification: This module is an Apalache-oriented wrapper for the c1cs specification, providing type annotations and a typed witness for the tuple of state variables. It declares constants, variables, a vars tuple, instantiates the separate module c1cs, and defines concrete values for the otherwise uninterpreted VALUE constants.
